decisions.decision_value: TV-only remote control without teletext, incorporating the company colours and slogan/logo

decisions.decision_value: Target young consumers aged 15 to 35 years old

decisions.decision_value: Use a simple battery (rejecting hand dynamo, kinetic energy, and solar panels)

decisions.decision_value: Include an interior LCD display with a spinning wheel inside a flip-open remote, powered by an advanced integrated circuit chip
decisions.rationale: Provides technological innovation and avoids interrupting the TV screen while protecting the LCD inside the flip cover

decisions.decision_value: Reclassify the banana-shaped rubber case as a flat surface rubber case instead of a single-curved surface to save cost
